# CANDIDATE: NAMED_LEVEL_VWAP_DIVERGENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price approaches a named resistance level but fails to hold VWAP, short-term selling pressure often triggers a reversal. This setup captures the edge by entering short at the close of a bar showing bearish sentiment and elevated volume near the level, with VWAP below the prior close indicating weakening buying pressure.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At bar close when ALL conditions are met:
- Price within 0.1% of a named resistance level (prior-day high, weekly high, or session high)
- VWAP < prior bar's close
- Bar is bearish (close < open)
- Volume > 20-bar average volume

**Exit:**
- Chart-stop: Named level + 0.2% buffer (primary invalidation)
- TP1: 1.5 × ATR from entry
- Runner: Trail stop at 10% below high-water mark after TP1
- Time stop: 15:50 ET
